items.item_text: Under the direction of the Principal Catering Manager and direct supervision of the Principal Supervisor, perform a variety of duties supporting catering and food service operations within the Department of Nutrition. Responsibilities include coordinating and executing catering event setups, food and beverage delivery, and post-event pickup. Ensure compliance with all applicable safety and sanitation standards, including Joint Commission (JC) and Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Point (HACCP) guidelines. Work collaboratively as an active member of the team, maintaining a strong commitment to customer service and supporting the department's mission to consistently exceed customer expectations.
Ability to read, speak, and write English to understand written communications, including memos, policies, and employee performance reviews (EPRs), and effectively communicate with customers.
Basic catering skills, including food delivery, event setup, buffet and sit-down service, food pre-plating, and espresso cart assistance.
Ability to organize and maintain clean and orderly workstations throughout the workday.
Knowledge of portion control, food presentation, and serving procedures.
Knowledge of retail food service operations, including station setup, replenishment, merchandising, and inventory procedures.
Strong interpersonal and customer service skills to support the department's mission of exceeding customer expectations.
Knowledge of and adherence to food safety, sanitation, and handling practices in accordance with HACCP and Joint Commission (JC) standards.
Ability to work independently and complete assigned responsibilities with minimal supervision.
Ability to assist with training and supporting peers as needed.
Ability to perform a variety of duties, adapt to changing priorities, and effectively manage multiple responsibilities.
Knowledge of and adherence to departmental, University, and hospital policies, including Environment of Care, property removal, dress code, punctuality, and attendance standards.
Ability to work collaboratively as a team member and participate in ongoing performance improvement initiatives.
Ability to stand, bend, walk, reach, lift, push, and pull for extended periods, including working in hot and cold environments.
Ability to lift, push, and pull 50 pounds or more.
Ability to safely work around and use strong cleaning solutions.
Ability to operate a catering van and drive between UCLA Health locations.
